rationale: The user asked to exchange a fleece jacket for a specific variant. The agent did not authenticate the user, did not confirm any order-changing action, and did not actually perform or document an exchange. Instead, the tool log shows a cancellation of order #W2466703 with reason “no longer needed” without any explicit user confirmation, which violates the policy. The final message implies success (“enjoy your new fleece jacket”) without evidence of creating an exchange or replacement order, making the information unsupported. Even if the orders belonged to the user, the lack of authentication, missing confirmation before a write, and failure to complete the requested exchange cause the interaction to fail the pass bar.
